lessons.title: Semantic HTML and keyboard interaction
lessons.intro:
Modern standards-mode browser; scripts execute after their referenced elements exist unless timing is the topic; await snippets are inside async functions. HTML elements carry behavior and accessibility semantics, not just appearance. Use buttons for actions and anchors with href for navigation. A native button supports keyboard activation; adding a click listener to a div does not provide the same behavior. Associate labels with controls and provide useful image alternatives according to purpose. Accessible names describe the action or destination. These foundations belong before styling or event-handler code.

lessons.title: CSS sizing, Grid, and responsive constraints
lessons.intro:
Modern standards-mode browser; scripts execute after their referenced elements exist unless timing is the topic; await snippets are inside async functions. CSS layout depends on the containing block, available space, and the selected layout model. Grid defines rows and columns; fr shares available space and minmax can express flexible bounds. border-box includes padding and borders inside a declared width. max-width can cap a fluid element without forcing it to overflow small screens. Read units and sizing constraints before assuming a pixel value is the final painted width.

lessons.title: Origins, storage, and page lifecycle
lessons.intro:
Modern standards-mode browser; scripts execute after their referenced elements exist unless timing is the topic; await snippets are inside async functions. Browser APIs have origin and lifecycle boundaries. localStorage stores strings and persists beyond a page reload for the origin, subject to browser policy and possible exceptions. JSON serialization preserves selected data, not functions or arbitrary object identity. A module script is deferred by default; DOMContentLoaded signals that parsing and deferred scripts have completed, not that every image has loaded. Fetch HTTP failures and network failures take different paths, so inspect Response.ok before trusting a body.
